aggressive_definition: No aggressive prostate cancer endpoint was analyzed in the abstract.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis among men enrolled in the PREDIMED trial.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A prospective cohort analysis was conducted among 2970 men aged 55-80 years at high cardiovascular risk from the PREDIMED trial, a multicenter study in Spain.
reason: The prospective analysis examines total incident prostate cancer and provides no aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Participants in the highest quartile of lycopene intake had a significantly lower risk of prostate cancer than those in the lowest quartile (HR: 0.46; 95% CI: 0.23-0.95; p-trend = 0.035).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for overall incident prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
